name: Condo managing agents (category guide)
summary: MCST vs managing agent roles — how tenants escalate noise/repairs, AGM/EOGM levers for owners, and why WhatsApp silence is a documentation problem.
body: In strata condos the Management Corporation Strata Title (MCST) council sets policy; a managing agent (MA) executes day-to-day ops under contract. Tenants usually go landlord → MA for common-property issues (leaks from common pipes, lobby noise enforcement); owners escalate via council if the MA ghosts. Forum heat centres on unresponsive MAs, missed AGMs, and fee hikes — document dates, photos, and written requests before AGM/EOGM politics. BCA / BMSMA frameworks govern councils; individual owners cannot casually fire an MA without council process. New buyers should read AGM minutes and MA contract length before completion. Distinct from tenant property agents (CEA sales/rental). This is a category guide, not a ranked MA firm list.
whenToEngage: Owner wants AGM / EOGM options on a failing MA
